feeds.title: Edinburgh Evening News
feeds.description: An Edinburgh and Lothians' perspective on news, sport, what's on, lifestyle and more, from Scotland's capital city paper, the Edinburgh Evening News.

feeds.title: Love Music Love Life News
feeds.description: Love Music Love Life is an Edinburgh based music blog established in 2010 sharing the latest music news, reviews and interviews from our favourite artists across the UK.

feeds.title: Tales of One City
feeds.description: Edinburgh Libraries are 'innovative on so many fronts, full of energy, bang up to date and unafraid of the future. This is a template for libraries everywhere to be inspired by'. This is how the judges of 'The Bookseller' magazine's Library of the Year Award described them. But one should not take their word for it - visit the local library and see for yourself.

feeds.title: Edinburgh Life With Kids
feeds.description: food fitness style design parenting Edinburgh with Kids is a magazine style lifestyle blog primarily for parents who are looking for fresh ideas although they welcome everyone else too. The blog offers simple, honest, inspiring and down to earth advice about food, fitness, style, design, parenting and many more.

feeds.title: The Edinburgers
feeds.description: The Edinburgers is a blog about eating experiences in and around Edinburgh and on our travels.

feeds.title: Karol Makula Blog
feeds.description: Karol Makula is a candid wedding photographer based in Edinburgh Specialized in photo journalism and contemporary photography for weddings throughout Scotland. Karol Makula provides natural, creative, fun photos in beautiful, candid and unique photography style.

feeds.title: Almost The Weekend
feeds.description: The Laid-Back Lifestyle blog, bringing more of that weekend feeling to your whole week. Come in, relax... it's almost the weekend.

feeds.title: Edinburgh Foody
feeds.description: Edinburgh Foody discovers, enjoys, eats and writes about ingredients, cooking, producers, baking, brewing, restaurants and chefs, often with an Edinburgh-centric or Scottish flavour. However, as they were all non-Scottish we will get a healthy portion of food from further afield too.

feeds.title: Edinburgh Emergency Medicine
feeds.description: Edinburgh Emergency Medicine deliver their service across 3 Departments in NHS Lothian to approximately 200,000 patients a year. They believe in clinical excellence, provided within a strong multidisciplinary team ethos and with patient care at its centre.

feeds.title: Food To Glow
feeds.description: Covers articles on Gluten-free, Sauce, soft food diet,, Vegan, easy recipe, lower carb and more. Food To Glow is a healthy, plant-focused omnivore with an occasional decadent twist. Kellie Anderson is a health educator, food writer and recipe developer.

feeds.title: The Red Door Gallery
feeds.description: The Red Door Gallery stock a huge selection of art prints from 100 illustrators (screenprints, giclee and digital prints) sitting alongside designer products, fashion accessories, knitware, unique homewares, jewellery, artist cards and wrap.

feeds.title: Iris Art
feeds.description: Iris Art Photography is a local company in Edinburgh & Glasgow covering everything from wedding photography, family and portrait photography and reportage photographer through to tailored packages.

feeds.title: School Guide Edinburgh
feeds.description: Edinburgh's only guide to provide parents a wealth of information about both state and independent schools with primary and secondary schools news, fees, facilities, exam results and much more. This guide is also a valuable resource for finding local clubs, classes and days out.

feeds.title: Auld Reekie Rants
feeds.description: The sometimes inane ramblings of a fiftysomething citizen of Edinburgh.

feeds.title: Teaching Matters Blog
feeds.description: Teaching Matters is the University of Edinburgh's blog for debate about learning and teaching, for sharing ideas and approaches to teaching, and for showcasing our successes, including academic colleagues who are leading the way in delivering brilliant teaching.

feeds.title: CodeBase
feeds.description: Codebase is the largest technology incubator in Scotland. We're built entirely on private equity and are home to some of the best companies in the count

feeds.title: Alive & Amplified | The Edinburgh Music Blog
feeds.description: Alive & Amplified is an Edinburgh based music website featuring blogs, news, podcasts, gig news and new releases from Scotland and beyond.

feeds.title: The Likely Lady Blog
feeds.description: Food, Travel and Lifestyle Blog find events, beauty product reviews, WIWT posts, local Scottish food & drinks reviews, homeware updates, lifestyle tips, travel guides and plenty of pretty pictures to whet your appetite.

feeds.title: University of Edinburgh Student Blog
feeds.description: In University of Edinburgh Student Blogs one will find a range of ever-expanding content about life at the University; from societies and studying, to internships and living in the city of Edinburgh. It also helps potential students to make an informed decision about their academic future.
